evals.prompt: Map this codebase for me, I'm new here and need to understand how it's put together before touching anything.
evals.expected_output: The script is run; the map at docs/engineering/architecture.md lists components (pages, components, stores, router, root files) with afferent and efferent counts equal to the script output, traces the Home.vue → catalog store → fetch path naming files, with ProductCard.vue rendered by Home.vue, lists VITE_API_URL as an integration signal read in src/stores/catalog.ts without naming a system the code does not name, notes the `~` alias defined in vite.config.ts, states the static-import limits, lists the files read, and contains no recommendation; the reply quotes the measurement command and git status --short, which shows only the map.
assertions: Every component row cites at least one path, and the Components table carries the script's module-level numbers (afferent/efferent): stores 2/0, components 1/0, pages 1/2, root files (src/main.ts, src/App.vue, src/router.ts and vite.config.ts) 0/2; the map says these numbers come from map_codebase.py

A traced path goes from src/pages/Home.vue (which calls the catalog store's load) to src/stores/catalog.ts and its fetch to VITE_API_URL/products, in that order; src/components/ProductCard.vue is described as rendered by Home.vue and nowhere as a caller of the store or of the fetch
The integration point for VITE_API_URL names where it is read (src/stores/catalog.ts) and does not state the external system's name or owner, which the code does not establish
The map states that framework auto-imports and dynamic imports are not counted

assertions.text: No sentence of the map contains should, could or consider; docs/engineering/architecture.md is the only file the run produced or changed, and the reply quotes `git status --short` showing no other project file

evals.expected_output: The script reports a likely monorepo (workspaces packages/*); the skill stops and asks which package to map, recommending exactly one with its reason (packages/web: it is an application, run with vite, while packages/shared is a library that packages/web imports; the rule of an application over a library decides, although packages/shared has more source files and comes first alphabetically), before reading any code.

assertions.text: The user is asked which package or directory to map before any map is written

assertions: The question recommends exactly one package, packages/web, and gives the rule that decided: packages/web is an application (its manifest runs vite) and packages/shared is a library that packages/web imports

assertions.text: No file under docs/engineering/ is among the files the run produced

evals.prompt: Map the code. There is already an ARCHITECTURE.md registered as our architecture document.
evals.expected_output: The map is written to docs/engineering/codebase-map.md, ARCHITECTURE.md is untouched, and the three disagreements between the specification and the code appear under Observations as facts, each quoting the specification with its line: state library (Vuex in src/store/index.ts against Pinia in src/stores/catalog.ts; src/store/index.ts does not exist), who renders ProductCard (App.vue against Home.vue), and who requests the products and how (Home.vue with axios against fetch in src/stores/catalog.ts; axios is not a dependency).
assertions: The output file is docs/engineering/codebase-map.md, not docs/engineering/architecture.md

assertions.text: ARCHITECTURE.md is not among the files the run produced or changed

assertions: Observations states, as a fact with locations and without a recommendation, that the specification says state is managed with Vuex in src/store/index.ts while the code uses Pinia in src/stores/catalog.ts and has no src/store/index.ts

Observations states, as a fact with locations and without a recommendation, that the specification says src/App.vue renders one ProductCard per product while the code renders ProductCard in src/pages/Home.vue and App.vue renders only the number of items

Observations states, as a fact with locations and without a recommendation, that the specification says src/pages/Home.vue requests the products with axios while the code makes the request with fetch in src/stores/catalog.ts and axios is not a dependency
